calibration.label: conservative initial value, not a carrier measurement

estimator.priors_status: pre-data uncalibrated heuristic priors frozen per BC-BODY1-18: not a calibration, not a physical bound; frozen before any 1c data and never retuned afterwards - a significant mismatch is reported as-is and returned to Acceptance
estimator.q_accel_mps2_derivation: heuristic process-noise scale frozen before any data: frozen target speed 2.0 m/s (scenario target.speed_mps) x turn rate 240 deg/s in rad/s (LoopTargetVehicle.cs:9). turnRate only rotates the body orientation via Quaternion.RotateTowards and does not constrain translation, so the product is an order-of-magnitude scale, not a physical bound on target translation
estimator.sigma_att_deg_derivation: no attitude-noise calibration source exists anywhere in the project; 1.0 deg is a conservative placeholder and nothing more
estimator.sigma_y_m_derivation: reuses the existing 0.05 m spatial tolerance (config/p1-m3-body-001-anchor-placement.json) only as a conservative scale; it is not ground-plane noise derived from the anchor support tolerance
estimator.initial_velocity_sigma_mps_derivation: conservative initial prior scaled to the frozen target speed (scenario target.speed_mps); not a measured standard deviation
estimator.note: batch 1 decisions never consume this estimate (BC-M34-3); the covariance is logged for batch 2 and the 1c NEES/NIS analysis, which reports consistency diagnostics under uncalibrated priors only - never a calibrated or validated estimator (BC-BODY1-18 (d))
